'''Brad Stinton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Geneva tournament]] on 10 June 2001 with YMSYL (walker deck with Garrisons) and CC Mains, according to . "Ulaire Fred" .'s tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2435">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-10-elvis-at-geneva-il-08-10d2435/ elvis-at-geneva-il-08-10], DeckTech (.
